name: DeleteGatewayAuth

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The response code. The value is fixed to 200 when Success is true

ClientId.description_en: The application ID registered with the service. Used for OIDC/IDaaS

ClientSecret.description_en: The application secret registered with the service. Used for OIDC/IDaaS

CookieDomain.description_en: The cookie domain name. After authentication succeeds, the cookie is sent to the specified domain name to maintain the logon state. Used for OIDC/IDaaS
CookieDomain.description_zh: Cookie的域名，认证通过后会将Cookie发送到指定的域名，保持登录状态（OIDC/IDaaS使用）

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

IsWhite.description_en:
The blacklist and whitelist mode for authorization. Valid values:

true: whitelist mode. The hosts and paths in the list can be accessed without verification. All other requests require verification.
false: blacklist mode. The hosts and paths in the list require verification. All other requests can be accessed directly
IsWhite.description_zh:
授权黑白名单模式：

true：白名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 不需要校验即可访问，其余都需要校验）
false：黑名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 需要校验，其余可直接访问）

Issuer.description_en:
Used when the authentication type is JWT or OIDC:

JWT: The iss (issuer) in JWT claims, which specifies the token issuer.
OIDC: The iss (issuer) in OIDC claims, which specifies the token issuer
Issuer.description_zh:
鉴权类型为JWT/OIDC时使用：

JWT：表示JWT claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人。
OIDC：表示OIDC claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人

Jwks.description_en: The JWT public key in JSON format

LoginUrl.description_en: The logon page URL of the IDaaS instance. Used for IDaaS
LoginUrl.description_zh: IDaaS实例用户登录页地址（IDaaS使用）

RedirectUrl.description_en: The redirect URL after successful authorization. Used for OIDC/IDaaS. This URL must be consistent with the redirect URL configured in OIDC/IDaaS
RedirectUrl.description_zh: 授权成功后的重定向地址（OIDC/IDaaS使用，需要与OIDC/IDaaS中配置的重定向地址保持一致。）

ScopesList.description_en: The OIDC scopes. Used for OIDC

items.description_en: The OIDC scopes. Used for OIDC

Status.description_en:
The enabled status. Valid values:

false: Disabled.

true: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。

未启用：false

启用：true

TokenName.description_en: The name of the token parameter to be verified. By default, the token is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix. Example: `Authorization: Bearer token`
TokenName.description_zh: 要校验的Token参数信息的名称，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`

TokenNamePrefix.description_en: The prefix of the JWT token

TokenPass.description_en: Indicates whether the token is passed through

TokenPosition.description_en:
The JWT token position. Valid values:

HEADER: Transmitted through the header.

The token parameter to be verified. By default, the token is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix. Example: Authorization: Bearer token
TokenPosition.description_zh:
JWT Token类型：

HEADER：通过Header传输

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：Authorization: Bearer token

Type.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ (self-managed authentication service)
Type.description_zh:
鉴权类型：

JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ（自建的鉴权服务）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.                                
`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：

`true`：请求成功。                                
`false`：请求失败
